name: deep-research-agent
description: Validates multi-step deep research packages and prepares detailed source-grounded reports with citation audit requirements.

metadata.trigger: when a user asks for deep research, a detailed report, a landscape review, or a multi-source evidence synthesis that should become a durable report
metadata.policy: Run web-first intake, decompose the research question, retrieve through multiple channels and iterations, rank sources, extract evidence, map contradictions, audit citations, write the report target, then run grounding before publication.
